bar_names.label: Target bars
bar_names.description: Bars to manage. Leave empty to follow Noctalia's configured bar order, or specify one or more names.

auto_zen_app_ids.label: Auto Zen app IDs
auto_zen_app_ids.description: Lua patterns for window app IDs to start in Zen Mode. Any match enables Zen; leave empty to disable.

auto_zen_titles.label: Auto Zen titles
auto_zen_titles.description: Lua patterns for window titles to start in Zen Mode. Any match enables Zen; leave empty to disable.

toggle_zen.label: Toggle zen
toggle_zen.description: Keep the widget visible and let it toggle the focused window into or out of Zen Mode.
